【原视频简介】
Experience a traditional nomadic lifestyle in the deep snow. See how we prepare meals from scratch while living in the mountains.

This footage captures the daily reality of remote living, focusing on the essential skills needed for survival and comfort in harsh environments. We walk through the entire process of traditional food preparation, starting with chopping onions and fresh liver to kneading dough by hand. Whether you are interested in self-sufficiency or just curious about how life functions away from modern amenities, these methods provide a unique look at sustenance in the wild.

You will watch the step-by-step techniques for outdoor cooking using a traditional oven built for the snowy mountains. We also share quieter moments, like brewing coffee inside a tent and coming together to enjoy a warm meal inside a cave with a fireplace. This is a practical demonstration of how nomadic lifestyle groups maintain their culinary traditions regardless of the weather conditions.

Subscribe for weekly explorations of remote cultures, and comment below to let us know which part of our setup you want to see next.
